osrs plugins 
---
Rival Radar — right-click a player and compare your last 7-day XP gains against theirs using WOM or TempleOSRS.
Boss KC Rival Lookup — right-click a player and instantly compare boss kill counts.
Achievement Gap Finder — compares your WOM achievements against a target player and shows what they have that you do not.
---
Skill Nemesis — pick a rival; plugin shows whether you or they gained more XP since last login.
---
Clan Grind Heatmap — overlay which clanmates gained the most XP today, this week, or this month.
“Who’s Grinding?” Clan Panel — live list of clanmates with recent XP gains from tracking APIs.
---
Personal Progress Timeline — in-game panel showing major milestones: 99s, boss KC thresholds, rank jumps, pets, collection log jumps.
---
Competition Overlay — shows your current rank in an active Wise Old Man or TempleOSRS competition.
---
Name Change Watcher — alerts when tracked friends/rivals change names using WOM name-change data. optional overlay over the players head with how many name changes he had 
---
all skill tracker lookup with url straight to the website lookup for the player 
Smart Hiscore Lookup++ — extends RuneLite’s Hiscore lookup with WOM/TempleOSRS tabs for gains, EHP, records, and achievements.
Account Legacy Card — generates a clean player card: account age estimate from tracking history, best records, top skills, favorite bosses.
---
Skill Streaks — counts consecutive days you gained XP in a chosen skill.
Boss Streaks — counts consecutive days/weeks with KC gains at a selected boss.
---
Nearby Player Snapshot — hover or right-click nearby player to show combat, total level, EHP, recent gains.
---
Skill Race Creator — create quick private races with friends for one skill over 1 hour, day, or week.
Boss Race Creator — same idea, but for boss KC gains.
---
Group Iron Progress Board — GIM-focused panel showing group member gains, boss KC, collection log, and missing roles.
---
Boss Readiness Score — estimates readiness for bosses based on stats, gear placeholders, quest unlocks, and comparable players.
    possible best in slot tool 
---
Friend Progress Feed — small feed like “Ali gained 1.2M Slayer XP today” or “Sara hit 500 Zulrah KC.”
---
